Visualization of KEGG pathways for apoptosis and P53 signaling in the pancreas of Pnlip T221M mice

Visualization of KEGG pathways for apoptosis and P53 signaling in the pancreas of Pnlip T221M mice.Five Pnlip T221M homozygous male mice and 5 WT controls at 1 month were analyzed by total RNA-seq as described in the Methods.The differently expressed genes compared with WT controls in each pathway was analyzed to map the graph
Download JPG
View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication

Diverse Misfolding Mutant Digestive Enzymes Cause Chronic Pancreatitis Through Common Pathways (2026) Steven J. Wilhelm, et al. Cell Mol Gastroenterol Hepatol. 2026;20(2). Figure: F17.
